combination: add path-only worktree

combination: explicit checkout detached add at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: explicit checkout add matches stock Git output and creates the detached worktree with checked-out file content

combination: skip checkout detached add at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: no-checkout add matches stock Git output, leaves only the gitfile in the new worktree, and omits the linked index file

combination: quiet detached add at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: quiet add suppresses stock feedback messages while still creating the detached worktree and matching linked state

combination: lock detached add with reason at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: lock add matches stock Git output and writes the linked worktree locked reason during creation

combination: list linked worktrees in porcelain format
repo_state: repository with detached, locked, and no-checkout linked worktrees
notes: porcelain list output matches stock Git across main, detached, locked, and no-checkout linked worktree entries

combination: add detached linked worktree at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: detached worktree add creates stock-readable linked checkout, porcelain list entry, and removable admin metadata like stock Git

combination: relocate linked worktree into existing parent directory
repo_state: repository with detached linked worktree
notes: move relocates linked worktree, preserves HEAD and worktree contents, and rewrites admin gitdir links like stock Git

combination: --reason plus unlock and remove lifecycle
repo_state: repository with detached linked worktree
stock_git_case: git worktree lock --reason "why now" <path>; git worktree unlock <path>; git worktree remove <path>
notes: lock reason, locked remove failure, unlock, and final remove match stock Git output and side effects

combination: --dry-run --verbose --expire=now plus prune removed linked worktree admin
repo_state: repository with deleted detached linked worktree
stock_git_case: git worktree prune --dry-run --verbose --expire=now; git worktree prune --expire=now
notes: dry-run prune reports the missing worktree and final prune removes stale admin metadata like stock Git

combination: repair moved linked worktree with incorrect admin gitdir
repo_state: repository with detached linked worktree moved outside Git
notes: repair rewrites incorrect admin gitdir linkage, preserves HEAD readability, and updates porcelain listing like stock Git

combination: repair moved linked worktree then flip back with --no-relative-paths
repo_state: repository with detached linked worktree moved outside Git
stock_git_case: git worktree repair --relative-paths <moved-path>; git worktree repair --no-relative-paths <moved-path>
notes: relative-path repair toggles admin gitdir and .git file path styles between relative and absolute like stock Git

combination: extensions.worktreeConfig=true plus linked worktree config set/get/list/unset
repo_state: repository with linked worktree and worktreeConfig extension
stock_git_case: git -C <linked-worktree> config --worktree demo.value linked; git -C <linked-worktree> config --worktree --unset demo.value
notes: worktree config scope writes linked-worktree-only config, keeps main worktree blind to the key, and matches stock Git file contents and failures

combination: worktree config denied without extensions.worktreeConfig in linked worktree
repo_state: repository with multiple worktrees but worktreeConfig extension disabled
notes: worktree config writes are rejected with stock-matching exit, stdout and stderr when the extension is disabled even in a linked worktree

combination: add existing branch worktree
repo_state: repository with existing local branch feature
notes: adding a worktree for an existing local branch preserves symbolic HEAD, checked-out commit, worktree contents, and porcelain branch reporting like stock Git

combination: force add second linked worktree for already checked out branch
repo_state: repository with existing local branch feature already checked out in another linked worktree
notes: forced branch reuse permits a second linked worktree for the already checked-out branch and preserves symbolic HEAD, checked-out commit, and worktree contents like stock Git

combination: add detached linked worktree at HEAD~1 via short alias
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: short detach alias matches stock Git output and creates the detached linked worktree with the same checked-out commit

combination: quiet detached add at HEAD~1 via short alias
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: short quiet alias suppresses stock feedback messages while still creating the detached linked worktree

combination: force add second linked worktree for already checked out branch via long option
repo_state: repository with existing local branch feature already checked out in another linked worktree
notes: long force option permits a second linked worktree for the already checked-out branch and preserves branch state like stock Git

combination: add worktree from commit-ish without explicit --detach
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits
notes: commit-ish add without branch options creates a detached linked worktree with stock-matching HEAD state, porcelain listing and file contents

combination: create new branch worktree at HEAD~1
repo_state: committed repository with at least two commits

combination: create unborn branch worktree from path basename

notes: orphan add creates an empty linked worktree on an unborn branch named from the path basename with stock-matching output and HEAD state

combination: create new branch worktree that tracks a remote branch
repo_state: local clone with remote-tracking branch origin/topic and no conflicting local feature-track branch
notes: explicit track mode creates the requested branch worktree, sets upstream to origin/topic, and matches stock Git output and checked-out commit

combination: create new branch worktree from remote branch without upstream tracking
repo_state: local clone with remote-tracking branch origin/topic and no conflicting local feature-no-track branch

combination: infer remote-tracking branch from path basename
repo_state: local clone with unique remote-tracking branch origin/topic and no local topic branch

combination: disable remote-tracking inference for path basename
repo_state: local clone with unique remote-tracking branch origin/noguess and no local noguess branch
notes: no-guess-remote keeps path-only branch creation based on local HEAD without upstream configuration even when a unique matching remote branch exists
